commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Prevents damage and restores Sigrid’s health.

commands.name: Unlimited glide
commands.description: Removes the time limit while holding the glide button.

commands.name: Maintain glide altitude
commands.description: Keeps Sigrid at the same altitude while gliding and allows normal steering.

commands.name: Unlimited jumps
commands.description: Lets you repeat the double jump in midair.

commands.name: Set money
commands.description: Sets the spendable Sparks balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

commands.name: Freeze minigame timers
commands.description: Pauses the countdown in timed activities such as races.

commands.name: Movement speed
commands.description: Scales Sigrid’s horizontal movement from 1× to 3×.
